definitions.gloss: to get through, to overcome, to survive
definitions.explanation: To successfully endure and get past a difficult situation, crisis, or challenging period.

examples.japanese: この{危機|きき}を{乗|の}り{切|き}ろう。
{厳|きび}しい{冬|ふゆ}をなんとか{乗|の}り{切|き}った。
examples.english: We somehow got through the harsh winter.

examples.japanese: チーム{全員|ぜんいん}で{協力|きょうりょく}して、{困難|こんなん}な{時期|じき}を{乗|の}り{切|き}ることができた。
examples.english: By cooperating as a whole team, we were able to get through the difficult period.

notes:
CONJUGATION: {乗|の}り{切|き}る is a godan verb. Te-form: {乗|の}り{切|き}って. Potential: {乗|の}り{切|き}れる.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {危機|きき}を{乗|の}り{切|き}る (to overcome a crisis)
- {困難|こんなん}を{乗|の}り{切|き}る (to get through difficulties)
- {夏|なつ}を{乗|の}り{切|き}る (to survive the summer)
- {不況|ふきょう}を{乗|の}り{切|き}る (to weather a recession)

This is a compound verb formed from {乗|の}る (to ride) + {切|き}る (to complete). The {切|き}る component adds the nuance of "completely" or "all the way through."
